summary: Tested Bug 1 (tab bar persistence) and Bug 2 (realtime history refresh) on Populus at 390x844. Both fixes verified. Tab bar (FAIDE + PROFILO) visible on /, /feud/<id>, /user/<id>, /archive, /admin with only TWO tab icons (no leaking of hidden screens). PROFILO tap from /feud/<id> navigates to /profile as expected. Profile refresh-on-focus works: total_votes counter and stats increment 0->1->2 without logout/login after casting votes elsewhere. History item appears on re-expand of STORICO VOTI. Anon /profile still shows anon-lock-screen (regression OK).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged repeatedly. Likely coming from a react-native-web component in the render tree. Non-blocking but should be addressed.

bug1_tab_bar_persistence.home: PASS - FAIDE + PROFILO visible, exactly 1 occurrence each
bug1_tab_bar_persistence.only_two_tabs: PASS - home shows FAIDE=1, PROFILO=1 (hidden screens do not create extra tab entries)
bug1_tab_bar_persistence.profilo_nav_from_feud: PASS - tap PROFILO on /feud/<id> navigates to /profile

bug2_history_refresh.profile_initial_empty: PASS - STORICO VOTI shows count 0, empty state 'Nessun voto in questa categoria.' rendered
bug2_history_refresh.total_votes_increment_on_focus: PASS - counter went 0 -> 1 after tapping PROFILO tab (refreshMe via useFocusEffect works). Second vote: 1 -> 2 on subsequent focus. Stats row also updated (VOTI=1, MAGGIORANZA=1).
bug2_history_refresh.history_item_appears_after_reexpand: PASS - history-<feud_id> element visible after expanding STORICO VOTI (loadHistory ran on focus with historyExpanded flag). No logout/login required.
bug2_history_refresh.history_stays_expanded_across_tabs: NOT_APPLICABLE - React Native Tabs unmounts the profile screen on tab switch, so historyExpanded local state resets to false (screen collapses). Request spec explicitly accepts this case: 'If it was collapsed, expand it -> the new vote is present.'

regression.admin_page: PASS - /admin renders 'PANNELLO ADMIN' with key input and tab bar visible (no crash)

action_items: OPTIONAL: If desired, persist historyExpanded state across tab switches (e.g., via zustand/context or lift state to root) so users returning to /profile don't have to re-expand STORICO VOTI. Current behavior meets the spec but is a mild UX regression.
MINOR: Address 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warnings emitted by react-native-web components.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly registers feud/[id], user/[id], archive, admin as hidden Tabs.Screen entries with href:null.

app/(tabs)/profile.tsx useFocusEffect implementation is correct: calls refreshMe() unconditionally and loadHistory(filter) when historyExpanded=true. Dependency array on the useCallback includes refreshMe, historyExpanded, loadHistory, filter which is correct.
No duplicate refresh calls: initial useEffect only calls refreshMe on mount, useFocusEffect handles subsequent focuses.
seed_data_creation: Signed up two fresh users via /api/auth/signup (tb2xur8f... and tb2b9yjov...) each with onboarding + votes cast. Also created anonymous user 'regressAnon' via /api/auth/anonymous.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 1 (tab bar persistence via (tabs)/ subroutes) and Bug 2 (useFocusEffect-driven refresh of profile stats/history) are both verified. Only minor UX consideration: historyExpanded state does not persist across tab navigation; spec accepts this.
